About the Team

The Integrity team builds the systems that protect OpenAI’s products, users, and ecosystem from abuse. We work across product engineering, infrastructure, safety, and operations to detect and prevent harmful, fraudulent, deceptive, and adversarial activity at global scale.

As OpenAI builds new ads experiences, we are establishing the integrity foundation that will keep the ads ecosystem safe and trustworthy from the start. This includes protecting advertiser onboarding, detecting unsafe or policy-violating ad content, preventing fraudulent and abusive advertiser behavior, and defending the ads ecosystem against spam, manipulation, and other forms of abuse.

Ads Integrity is a new and highly cross-functional area. The team partners closely with Ads, Product, Safety, Policy, ML, Privacy, Security, and operations teams to build protections directly into the ads platform rather than layering them on after the fact. This is an opportunity to define how integrity works for a new ads ecosystem from first principles.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer to build the backend systems and infrastructure that keep OpenAI’s ads products safe, trustworthy, and resilient to abuse.

In this foundational role, you will design systems that detect, prevent, and respond to harmful, deceptive, fraudulent, or policy-violating activity across the ads lifecycle. The problems span advertiser onboarding and verification, account and behavioral risk, content safety, spam and fraudulent interactions, detection and enforcement infrastructure, and the systems that connect integrity signals and models to real-time product decisions.

This is not an ML-specialist role, but familiarity with ML for Ads integrity is always welcome. You’ll work closely with ML engineers and researchers and build systems that consume and operationalize ML-based signals, but your primary focus will be designing and operating robust backend and distributed systems. You’ll help determine how signals, rules, models, and human review come together into reliable integrity protections for advertisements that can operate at OpenAI scale.

This role is particularly well suited to an engineer who has built large-scale systems in integrity, trust and safety, anti-abuse, fraud, risk, security, or a related adversarial domain.

You will have significant ownership over what we build and how we build it, partnering across Integrity and Ads to establish the architecture and technical foundations that will protect OpenAI’s ads ecosystem as it grows.

This role is based in San Francisco. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Design and build large-scale backend systems that detect and prevent harmful, deceptive, fraudulent, or policy-violating activity across the ads ecosystem.

- Build low-latency integrity infrastructure capable of evaluating risk signals and making decisions in or near real time.

- Develop scalable risk-signal pipelines, decision systems, rules and enforcement infrastructure across the advertiser and ads lifecycle.

- Build advertiser onboarding, business verification, account-risk, fraud-detection, and abuse-prevention capabilities that make it harder for malicious actors to enter or exploit the ecosystem.

- Develop systems that support ads-specific content safety and enable the detection and enforcement of unsafe, misleading, deceptive, or policy-violating ads.

- Build protections against spam, fraudulent interactions, manipulation, and other adversarial behaviors that threaten the health of the ads ecosystem.

- Partner with ML teams to integrate classifiers and model-based signals into production integrity systems, including both lightweight real-time protections and more sophisticated asynchronous detection.

- Build feedback loops, review systems, and integrity metrics that improve detection quality while carefully managing false positives and impact on legitimate advertisers and users.

- Create tooling and infrastructure that enable operations and policy teams to investigate abuse and make fast, consistent, and explainable decisions.

- Engineer systems that adapt as adversaries change their tactics and support effective experimentation, monitoring, and incident response.

- Partner closely with Ads Engineering to integrate integrity protections throughout the ads platform without compromising reliability, latency, or product quality.

- Help define the technical strategy and architecture for Ads Integrity as both the product and underlying threat landscape evolve.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have significant experience building and operating large-scale backend or distributed systems.

- Have worked on integrity, trust and safety, anti-abuse, fraud, risk, security, business verification, or another domain where systems must operate against sophisticated or evolving adversaries.

- Have built detection, decisioning, enforcement, verification, investigation, or risk infrastructure in production.

- Understand how rules, heuristics, risk signals, ML-based signals, and human review can work together within a dependable production system.

- Are comfortable building ML-adjacent infrastructure and partnering closely with ML teams without needing to be an ML domain expert.

- Have built low-latency, high-throughput services or data pipelines with demanding reliability, correctness, privacy, and security requirements.

- Can reason about false positives, adversarial behavior, explainability, auditability, and the operational impact of automated enforcement.

- Think holistically about threat models, system architecture, data quality, observability, user impact, and ecosystem health.

- Can define technical direction in an ambiguous 0→1 environment and independently drive complex work across teams.

- Communicate clearly and work effectively across engineering, product, policy, safety, security, operations, and machine-learning teams.

- Have experience with ads, ads integrity, advertiser systems, or ads fraud. This is a plus, but not a requirement.

- Are excited to build the integrity foundation for a new product area rather than inherit a mature system.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking a Manager, Infrastructure Capex Accounting to join our Infrastructure Accounting team. In this role, you will execute day-to-day accounting for Anthropic's owned infrastructure assets — the GPUs, networking equipment, and data center buildouts underpinning our recently announced $50bn investment in American computing infrastructure. As we continue our rapid growth, you will help ensure the operational scalability and financial accuracy of the core functions that enable Anthropic's research and commercial success.

This is an opportunity to be at the heart of one of the fastest-scaling companies in the industry, and to shape how Anthropic's growing fixed asset base is accounted for and understood across the business.

You will own end-to-end accounting for Anthropic's capex and fixed asset portfolio, working closely with cross-functional partners across Data Center Operations, Finance, and Legal. You'll apply deep technical accounting expertise under ASC 360, and help build the processes, controls, and systems that let this function scale.

Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end accounting for Anthropic's AI infrastructure capex and fixed asset portfolio, including monthly close, construction-in-progress (CIP) tracking, reconciliations, roll-forwards, and flux analysis
• Apply technical accounting expertise to complex infrastructure arrangements under ASC 360 (capitalization, useful lives, impairment, disposals, and asset retirement obligations)
• Partner with Data Center Operations, Legal, and Finance teams during contract negotiation and execution to ensure accounting implications are understood before commitments are made
• Serve as a trusted finance partner to non-finance stakeholders — explaining the financial statement impact of their decisions in clear, simple terms they can act on
• Collaborate cross-functionally to improve the quality of upstream data pipelines from operational and contract systems, particularly around asset receipt, deployment, and in-service dates
• Help design and scale systems, processes, and controls to support a rapidly growing fixed asset portfolio
• Collaborate with and mentor junior accounting professionals across the Infrastructure Accounting team
• Serve as a key point of contact with external auditors on fixed asset and capex accounting matters
• Drive process improvements and automation, including leveraging AI tooling, to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of financial reporting

You may be a good fit if you

• Have 7+ years of progressive experience in accounting, with operational experience at technology or infrastructure-heavy companies
• Hold a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA or equivalent preferred
• Possess strong technical accounting knowledge of ASC 360, particularly as applied to infrastructure, data center, or compute-related assets
• Have hands-on experience with a significant fixed asset portfolio in a high-growth environment
• Demonstrate strong analytical abilities and comfort working with large, complex datasets
• Have a track record of improving scalable financial processes in fast-moving environments
• Have experience mentoring junior accounting professionals
• Are adept at translating technical accounting concepts into financial implications for non-finance stakeholders
• Communicate clearly and influence effectively across cross-functional partners
• Have experience partnering with engineering, infrastructure, or operations teams to improve financial reporting and cost transparency

Strong candidates may have

• Experience at hyperscalers, large compute consumers, or data center operators with exposure to infrastructure asset structures (including GPU clusters, networking equipment, and data center buildouts)
• Experience with fixed asset subledger systems at scale
• SQL proficiency for querying and analyzing large infrastructure and accounting datasets
• Background in Big 4 accounting or advisory services combined with industry experience
• Experience with complex data center buildouts or hybrid cloud / on-premise environments
• Knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure and associated cost structures
• Experience applying AI tooling (including Claude) to accounting processes, memo drafting, or close automation
• Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and drive results in rapidly changing environments

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$160,000—$190,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Data Center Technician position involves in-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, and carrying out routine network, server hardware, and operating system repairs to contribute to the overall availability of AWS services
- Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
- Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
- Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
- Helping to interview, train and onboard new team members
Physical Requirements:
- Lifting and moving material up to 40 pounds each
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
- Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in an industrial environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).
- This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

- Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
Our Data Center Technician professionals, who have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while they:
- Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
- Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
- Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
- Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting
- Are biased to act in the absence of direction or support
- Improve effectiveness through process innovation
You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays.

DoorDash for Business provides meals solutions to companies, but we aren’t stopping there. Our mission is to become a premier benefits partner for executives, employees and administrators across the globe, leveraging the DoorDash platform to deliver industry-leading selection, quality, and customer service to every business customer, for every business use case. About the Role

As a Manager, Strategy & Operations (Audience Growth & Product Strategy), you will play a critical role in shaping how DoorDash for Business grows its customer base, expands platform adoption, and identifies new product opportunities that can accelerate the business.

You will own the strategy for growing our audience of companies, including how we identify, prioritize, acquire, activate, and expand across key customer segments, personas, industries, and use cases. You will also own product growth strategy for our core platform, helping define how we increase adoption, engagement, retention, and customer value across existing products.

In addition, you will help identify and evaluate net-new product opportunities that can unlock future growth. This includes sizing opportunities, understanding customer pain points, validating demand, shaping early GTM strategy, and partnering with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Analytics, and Finance to determine where DoorDash for Business should invest.

A core part of this role will be owning the voice of the customer. You will create structured feedback loops that capture insights from executives, administrators, employees, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and market research, then translate those insights into clear recommendations that inform product roadmaps and business priorities.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of growth strategy, product strategy, analytics, customer insight, and cross-functional execution.

Reporting to the Head of Growth Strategy and Operations, DoorDash for Business, you will work closely with operators, field teams, product and other teams to make your vision a reality.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

Develop audience growth and product growth strategies for DoorDash for Business, identifying the highest-impact customer segments, personas, use cases, and product opportunities to grow the business.

Job Description Summary

As a Payroll Analyst at Taylor Morrison Home Funding Inc., you will own payroll end to end for multiple companies under Financial Services, spanning multiple states and entities. Every pay cycle, you make sure each team member is paid accurately, on time, and in full compliance. Between cycles, you shift into analyst mode: calculating commissions and monthly production bonuses across our mortgage and title operations, building proformas, and helping shape how our sales teams are paid.

This role comes with a seat at the table. People, Finance, and operational leaders will look to your numbers before they make decisions. If you have strong attention to detail, find satisfaction in untangling a complicated commission plan, and want your work to be visible rather than tucked away in a back office, you will do well here.

Job Details

What You’ll Do
Payroll Operations

• o Process bi-weekly payroll for multiple companies and states, including new hires, status changes, terminations, and payroll adjustments
• o Audit payroll transactions and reports to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance prior to each pay run
• o Manage and maintain employee payroll records within ADP Workforce Now and related HRIS platforms
• o Maintain accurate records for garnishments, PTO accruals, and off-cycle or manual check requests
• o Research and resolve payroll inquiries from team members and leaders while delivering on the "Love the Customer" commitment by building trusted relationships and ensuring an exceptional customer experience
• o Identify and implement process improvements that enhance efficiency, accuracy, and the team member experience

Commissions & Incentive Compensation

• o Manage the calculation and distribution of monthly commissions and bonus programs for multiple companies, ensuring accuracy and timely payouts, while working closely with accounting for payroll accrual entries
• o Process monthly production bonuses for departments across mortgage operations and title operations, partnering with department leaders to confirm eligibility, metrics, and payout accuracy
• o Administer executive sales commission agreements, ensuring payments are calculated, documented, and paid in accordance with the terms of each agreement
• o Develop and maintain annual financial proformas supporting sales contract pricing, aligning projected company growth and business needs with commission and incentive compensation plans
• o Partner with department heads and Finance leadership to model the impact of proposed plan changes before they are implemented

Compliance & Reporting

• o Ensure payroll practices comply with federal, state, and local wage and hour regulations across all operating jurisdictions
• o Support internal and external audits, including 401(k), workers’ compensation, and year-end payroll audits
• o Prepare ad hoc payroll reports and business insights for stakeholders
• • Business Partnership
• o Partner with People, Finance, and operational leaders to support payroll excellence across the Financial Services companies
• o Translate payroll and compensation data into insights that inform leadership decisions
• o Maintain data integrity across payroll and HRIS systems, serving as a subject matter resource for the business
• o Review and lead staffing and payroll calls with senior leadership to discuss payroll variance and trends
• • Perform other duties as assigned

Sound Like You?
You are precise, curious, and comfortable owning the numbers. You care about getting it right and about what the numbers mean. If that sounds like you, here’s what else we’re looking for:

• • 4+ years of payroll administration, payroll analysis, or related payroll experience required
• • High School Diploma or equivalate required; Bachelor’s degree preferred[KC2.1]
• • ADP Workforce Now processing experience required
• • Experience processing multi-state payroll across multiple entities
• • Demonstrated ability to calculate commissions and incentive payouts across multiple plan structures
• • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain proformas and financial models supporting compensation planning
• • Experience administering and interpreting executive sales commission agreements
• • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong systems aptitude
• • Working knowledge of federal and multi-state wage and hour regulations
• • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and confidentiality
• • Ability to manage multiple competing priorities

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt
This position is considered a non-exempt position for purposes of wage-hour law, which means that you will be required to keep a time record and will be eligible for overtime pay.

Essential Functions:
Successful job applicants will be able to perform these functions. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
• Adhere to work schedule and location
• Ability to access, input, and retrieve information from a computer and/or electronic device
• Ability to have face to face conversations with co-workers, employees and higher level managers
• Ability to sit or stand for long periods of time and move around work environment as needed
• Comply with company policies and procedure

Physical Demands:
• Must be able to able to remain in a stationary position up to 50% of the time
• The ability to frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds

*Taylor Morrison Home Funding experience and/or successful completion of training program may override required education and/or experience requirement.

Job descriptions are not intended as, nor should be construed to be, exhaustive lists of all responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with a job. They are intended to be accurate reflections of those principal job duties and responsibilities essential for making fair pay decisions about the job.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Beneficial Deployments:

Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.

About the Role:

We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join our Beneficial Deployments team, focused on maximizing the impact of Claude in the life sciences. Our goal is ambitious: accelerate scientific progress from R&D through translation by an order of magnitude. That means making Claude the go-to tool for the life sciences ecosystem from early discovery in academia to paradigm shifting biotech to reimaging pharma pipelines — and building the technical infrastructure to back that up.

You'll work directly with flagship research partners like Howard Hughes Medical Institute and The Allen Institute, embedded in their scientific workflows. This isn't consulting from the outside — you'll be building alongside their engineers, prototyping agents that fit into real research pipelines, and developing the ecosystem-level tooling (MCP servers, benchmarks, reusable agent skills) that extends Claude's usefulness across the broader life sciences community. This role will be part of the founding Beneficial Deployments applied AI team focused on bringing more of life sciences closer to the frontier and be responsible for building with our partners.

Responsibilities:

•

Partner deeply with flagship life sciences research institutions — understand their scientific workflows end-to-end, build hands-on with their engineering teams, and help take projects from early exploration to production systems integrated into how they do science day-to-day.

•

Develop reusable ecosystem infrastructure, like MCP servers for domain-specific data sources (genomics platforms, literature databases, experimental repositories), instruments, scientifically-grounded benchmarks, and agent skills that other institutions can adopt without starting from scratch.

•

Identify what's actually hard about deploying AI in life sciences (heterogeneous data, auditability requirements, the prototype-to-trust gap) and feed those findings back to product, engineering, and research.

•

Create technical content and documentation that lets partners self-serve, so what works for one institution can scale globally without the same level of hand-holding.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have:

•

4+ years as a Software Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, or technical founder — with production experience shipping systems that real users depend on.

•

Deep research experience in life sciences, biomedical research, or scientific computing. Bonus if you've studied genomics, neuroscience, or drug discovery specifically and are comfortable getting deeply technical with academics.

•

Experience building LLM-powered tools or applications: prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks.

•

Builder credibility from shipping production code as a software engineer, forward-deployed engineer, or technical founder.

•

A scrappy mentality–comfortable wearing multiple hats, building from scratch, driving clarity in ambiguous situations, and doing whatever it takes to further the mission.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$280,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

About the role

We are looking for an M&A Tax Director to join our Tax Team at Anthropic. As the company pursues an active and growing pipeline of acquisitions, acqui-hires, data center investments, joint ventures and other strategic transactions, this role will be a core member of our transactions tax function, working closely with our M&A Tax Lead. Assistant Vice President, Privacy Engineering, Wealth Services

Who we are looking for

The State Street Global Privacy Office is seeking an Assistant Vice President, Privacy Engineering, to support Wealth Services and other consumer-facing activities. Reporting to the Vice President, Privacy Engineering, this United States-based role will embed Privacy by Design into products, systems, technology initiatives, third-party solutions, and business processes involving consumer and retail investor personal data.

This role can be performed in a hybrid model, where you can balance working from home and the office to match your needs and role requirements.

Why this role is important to us

As Wealth Services expands its consumer-facing activities, it is creating new privacy considerations involving retail investor data, digital products, data sharing, adviser and processor relationships, artificial intelligence, profiling, and emerging technologies. Wealth Privacy serves as the first point of contact for most privacy matters within the business unit, helping stakeholders identify applicable requirements, engage the appropriate Global Privacy Office specialists, and obtain coordinated, practical, and risk-based privacy advice.

This is a greenfield opportunity to help shape and advance Privacy Engineering as the Wealth model is further developed and rolled out globally. You will lead innovation in collaboration with the first line of defense, Global Cybersecurity, Technology, Data Governance, Legal, Compliance, and other governance functions, helping embed practical privacy requirements into new products, systems, and processes from the outset.

What you will be responsible for

As an Assistant Vice President within the Global Privacy Office, you will:

• Serve as a primary Privacy contact for Wealth Services, coordinating matters across the business and the Global Privacy Office and involving relevant specialists where required.
• Embed Privacy by Design into Wealth Services products, strategic programs, technology initiatives, third-party solutions, and business processes.
• Conduct Privacy Impact Assessments, Data Protection Impact Assessments, and other privacy risk assessments; document risks and recommend proportionate treatment.
• Analyze business processes, system architecture, data flows, data uses, sharing arrangements, and technical controls involving consumer and retail investor personal data.
• Assess privacy risks involving minimization, purpose limitation, retention, deletion, anonymization, access, logging, monitoring, cross-border transfers, and onward disclosures.
• Review artificial intelligence, machine learning, profiling, automated decision-making, advanced analytics, and other emerging technologies and provide risk-based recommendations and challenge.
• Assess vendor, processor, and third-party privacy risk, including complex data-sharing and adviser relationships.
• Evaluate privacy control design, operating effectiveness, remediation plans, and supporting evidence while preserving first-line accountability for implementing and operating controls.
• Develop and improve Privacy Engineering standards, methodologies, playbooks, templates, technology, workflow automation, and AI-enabled assessment capabilities.
• Partner with Business, Technology, Information Security, Legal, Compliance, Enterprise Technology Risk Management, Data Governance, DPO Services, and other stakeholders on coordinated privacy outcomes.
• Monitor regulatory and technology developments and prepare clear assessments, metrics, governance updates, executive summaries, and presentations.

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

• Strong Privacy Engineering, technology risk, data lifecycle, information security, or related experience.
• Practical knowledge of Privacy by Design, privacy assessments, data flows, system architecture, lifecycle controls, artificial intelligence, cloud services, and third-party risk.
• Sound judgment and the ability to provide practical, proportionate, and risk-based advice and challenge in a regulated environment.
• Ability to communicate complex privacy and technology concepts clearly to technical, business, and senior audiences.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project-management skills, with close attention to detail.
• A collaborative, proactive approach and the ability to build trusted relationships across global, cross-functional teams.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Data Governance, Business, Law, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
• Approximately 5-8+ years of relevant experience in privacy, data protection, Privacy Engineering, information security, technology risk, data governance, compliance, or a related field, preferably in financial services or another regulated industry.
• Working knowledge of applicable US and global privacy requirements and experience conducting privacy assessments and supporting Privacy by Design programs.
• Experience with consumer data, digital products, data architecture, cloud technology, artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, third parties, or privacy technology is advantageous.
• A professional privacy certification such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, or an equivalent qualification is preferred; a relevant technology, security, risk, data, audit, or financial-services certification is beneficial.

Are you the right candidate? Yes!

We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy describes what we are looking for, you do not necessarily need to fulfill every requirement when applying. If you embrace change and innovation, seek to understand the bigger picture, make data-driven decisions, and work effectively as part of a team, you could be a great fit.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role:

Anthropic’s performance and scaling teams focus on making the most efficient and impactful use of our compute resources, be it inference or training. As an Engineering Manager on these teams you will be responsible for ensuring you and your team are identifying and removing bottlenecks, building robust and durable solutions, and maximizing the efficiency of our systems. You also will help bring clarity, focus, and context to your teams in a fast paced, dynamic environment.

Responsibilities:

• Provide front-line leadership of engineering efforts to improve model performance and scale our inference and training systems
• Become familiar with the team’s technical stack enough to make targeted contributions as an individual contributor
• Manage day-to-day execution of the team's work
• Prioritize the team’s work and manage projects in a highly dynamic, fast paced environment
• Coach and support your reports in understanding, and pursuing, their professional growth
• Maintain a deep understanding of the team's technical work and its implications for AI safety

You may be a good fit if you:

• Have 1+ years of management experience in a technical environment, particularly performance or distributed systems
• Have a background in machine learning, AI, or a similar related technical field
• Are deeply interested in the potential transformative effects of advanced AI systems and are committed to ensuring their safe development
• Excel at building strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels
• Are a quick learner, capable of understanding and contributing to discussions on complex technical topics
• Have experience managing teams through periods of rapid growth and change
• Are a quick study: this team sits at the intersection of a large number of different complex technical systems that you’ll need to understand (at a high level of abstraction) to be effective

Strong candidates may also have experience with:

• High performance, large-scale ML systems
• GPU/Accelerator programming
• ML framework internals
• OS internals
• Language modeling with transformers

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$500,000—$850,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. The Software Engineering Manager, Investment Technologies leads one or more agile engineering teams responsible for designing, delivering, operating, and continuously improving technology solutions that support RGA’s global Investments organization and investment accounting operations. This role combines people leadership, delivery accountability, engineering depth, and working knowledge of the investment lifecycle to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, resilient, and auditable technology outcomes.

The manager partners with Product Management, investment professionals, operations, accounting, architecture, data, security, risk, and vendor teams to modernize applications, workflows, APIs, integrations, and data capabilities spanning the front, middle, and back office. The role establishes a high-performing engineering culture, develops talent, manages capacity and financial commitments, and ensures teams deliver in alignment with RGA’s technology strategy, Product Delivery Operating Model, engineering standards, and regulatory obligations.

Principal Duties

• Engineering Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop software engineers across the full employee lifecycle; set clear expectations, strengthen technical capability, promote inclusion and accountability, and build succession and workforce plans aligned to the product roadmap.

• Delivery Accountability: Own predictable delivery and operational outcomes for the team’s products and services, balancing business features, regulatory commitments, platform modernization, technical debt, reliability, and production support.

• Investment Business Partnership: Develop trusted relationships with Investments, Investment Operations, and Investment Accounting leaders; understand business processes and control points across portfolio management, trading, settlement, positions, valuations, performance, risk, cash, securities accounting, reconciliation, and financial reporting.

• Product and Agile Execution: Partner with Product Management and Product Owners to shape roadmaps, refine outcomes, manage dependencies, plan capacity, and translate investment-business needs into well-defined engineering work within an agile, product-oriented operating model.

• Architecture and Technical Direction: Partner with solution, enterprise, data, cloud, and security architects to implement target-state architecture and approved patterns across applications, APIs, integration, data, and infrastructure. Ensure teams make sound design decisions without shifting architectural accountability away from designated architecture roles.

• Software Engineering Excellence: Establish and uphold standards for secure coding, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, documentation, release management, and maintainability. Remain technically close enough to delivery to evaluate designs, coach engineers, remove impediments, and make informed trade-offs.

• Cloud, Data, and Integration Delivery: Guide delivery of modern web applications, services, data pipelines, and integrations using cloud-native, serverless or containerized patterns; API-first services; event-driven, streaming, batch, and file-based integration; and modern analytical data platforms.

• Vendor Ecosystem Management: Oversee engineering around investment platforms and external providers—including order and portfolio management, investment accounting, private markets, market data, custodians, and analytics solutions—and contribute to build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions, vendor performance, upgrades, and integration strategies.

• Reliability and Operations: Ensure production services meet expectations for availability, recoverability, performance, monitoring, incident response, problem management, and disaster recovery. Use operational metrics and root-cause analysis to improve service health and reduce recurring issues.

• Risk, Security, and Controls: Embed security, privacy, segregation of duties, data lineage, traceability, logging, evidence retention, and other control requirements into delivery. Partner with Information Security, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Finance to support SOX ITGC, SOC 1/2, model governance, and related obligations.

• Financial and Resource Management: Manage team budget, vendor spend, staffing mix, hiring, capacity, and forecasts; make transparent trade-offs and ensure resources are aligned to the highest-value business outcomes.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Evaluate emerging technologies—including generative AI and agentic engineering tools—and introduce them responsibly to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and investment workflows while adhering to security, data, legal, and model-risk requirements.

• Stakeholder Communication: Communicate delivery progress, operational health, risks, dependencies, investment needs, and decisions clearly to audiences ranging from engineers and business specialists to senior executives.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Required.

• Master’s degree in a relevant technology, engineering, business, finance, or quantitative discipline. Preferred.

Work Experience

• 9+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, application development, platform engineering, data engineering, or related technology disciplines. Required.

• 3+ years of formal people-management experience leading software engineering teams, including performance management, coaching, hiring, workforce planning, and talent development. Required.

• Demonstrated accountability for delivering and operating business-critical technology products or platforms in a complex enterprise environment. Required.

• Experience supporting investments, asset management, investment accounting, capital markets, treasury, finance, or other financially oriented business capabilities. Required.

• Experience in insurance or reinsurance, an insurer general account, asset management, banking, pension, or an investment-platform provider. Preferred.

• Experience operating in an agile, product-oriented technology organization and partnering with Product Management, architecture, security, data governance, risk, and business stakeholders. Required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Strong knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including object-oriented and functional design, modular services, APIs, event-driven architecture, automated testing, secure software development, source control, CI/CD, observability, and infrastructure as code.

• Working fluency across modern application, data, and cloud technologies. Relevant experience may include Python, Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, React-class front ends, SQL, REST or GraphQL APIs, Terraform, containers, serverless computing, workflow orchestration, and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake.

• Hands-on understanding of AWS or a comparable public-cloud ecosystem, including compute, containers, serverless services, eventing, identity and access management, networking, monitoring, resilience, and cost management.

• Practical knowledge of investment data and processes, including trade lifecycle, positions and transactions, security master and reference data, pricing and valuations, cash, corporate actions, performance and risk, reconciliation, and interfaces between investment operations and investment accounting.

• Understanding of front-, middle-, and back-office operating models and of investment-book and accounting-book concepts such as IBOR and ABOR; familiarity with performance or planning books and multi-basis accounting is beneficial.

• Knowledge of one or more asset classes such as fixed income, public equity, derivatives, structured assets, private credit, real estate, or other private markets investments.

• Ability to lead engineering teams integrating with major investment platforms, accounting systems, market-data providers, custodians, and internal data platforms. Experience with platforms such as Aladdin, Bloomberg, SimCorp, Eagle, Clearwater, PAM-class systems, or comparable products is beneficial but not required for every candidate.

• Understanding of financial and insurance control environments, including auditability, data lineage, access controls, change management, segregation of duties, model governance, SOX ITGC, and SOC reporting.

• Strong judgment in balancing delivery speed, business value, architectural alignment, risk, quality, operational resilience, and total cost of ownership.

• Advanced leadership, communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate between investment, accounting, risk, and engineering audiences.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and dependencies, make timely decisions with incomplete information, and create clarity for teams operating through transformation.

• Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning, inclusive leadership, constructive feedback, and a culture in which engineers are empowered to own outcomes.

Preferred Experience

• Insurance or reinsurance general-account investments, including statutory, GAAP, or other multi-basis investment accounting and reporting.

• Asset-liability management and the interface among Investments, Finance, Risk, Treasury, and Actuarial functions.

• Private credit, private markets, structured assets, or alternative-investment platforms and workflows.
